title: Custom Hooks with Types
description: Learn how to create typed custom hooks.

data.text: Custom hooks are functions that use other hooks. They can have typed parameters and return values.

data.title: Custom Hook
Parameterized Hook
Return Tuple for Flexibility
data.text: Returning a tuple instead of an object lets consumers name the variables: const [data, loading] = useFetch<User[]>('/api/users')

terms.definition: A custom hook that works with multiple types
Fixed-length array with typed elements, great for hooks
Named properties, better for hooks with many values

data.title: Custom Hook Best Practices
items: Start with a descriptive name starting with 'use'
Define a return type interface for complex hooks
Use generics when the hook handles different data types
Return tuples for simple hooks, objects for complex ones

data.title: Exercise: Create a useLocalStorage Hook
data.description: Build a typed custom hook for syncing state with localStorage.
steps: Type the key as string and initial value as T
Return a tuple with state and setter
Add a second exercise for SSR safety
data.expectedOutcome: A reusable, typed useLocalStorage hook that persists data across sessions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Custom hooks are functions using other hooks
data.takeaway: Well-typed custom hooks are reusable and safe.
